title: Global dynamics of a supercritical wave equation in a large data regime
summary: We prove the existence of global solutions to the nonlinear wave equation in $\mathbb{R}^{1+3}$ $$Φ_{tt} - ΔΦ\pm Φ|Φ|^{p-1} = 0$$ in the energy-supercritical regime $p>5$, for a class of large initial data. Our initial data can be decomposed into two pieces, one which is dispersed in the sense of having large $L^2$ norm, while the other piece takes a localised short-pulse form. Consequently, we can obtain global existence for a class of initial data which is large in every homogeneous Sobolev norm $\dot{H}^s_x$ with $s \geq 0$.
